hints.content:
The function is decreasing, so the left Riemann sum will overestimate the actual area:

![The graph of function h has the shaded area divided into 7 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/d5e4dca2c325f6be54612f03ec8d8bc9f22e89b8)

And the right Riemann sum will underestimate:

![The graph of function h has the shaded area divided into 7 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/08dc4a0cd08b102e1edc49e13893bef6ef3d4cc2)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Right Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Left Riemann sum
